text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali receives Polish parliament speaker Josef Zych; they discuss bilateral cooperation.
- Prime Minister Karoui meets Libyan counterpart Gu'ud on bilateral cooperation and Arab Maghreb Union issues.
- Chairman of international committee of Mediterranean Games Claude Collard ends two-day visit to Tunisia confident about organization of next Mediterranean Games to be held in Tunisia in 2001.
- Cooperation and Foreign Investment Minister Ghannouchi visits United Arab Emirates to discuss opportunities for partnership and investment cooperation.
- Sadok Gmati named commandant of National Guard.
- President Ben Ali says in message to Arab sociologists meeting in Tunisian resort of Hammamet they must go deeply into study of social phenomena and watch society's mutations.
- Tunisia and France to set up centre to encourage youth-managed firms.
- Training Minister Rouissi says he wants to encourage emergence of privately run training market.
